evaluation.point_result_requirement: exact byte-value reproduction of every registered parent point-result field
evaluation.query_calibration_reference: full-low-rank source residuals; one shared scalar scale and radius reused unchanged by both controls

dependence_controls.diagonal_marginal_matched: remove every low-rank factor and transfer its row-wise variance to the diagonal
dependence_controls.scrambled_marginal_matched: preserve every low-rank factor-row norm while deterministically permuting row directions and signs

query_bank.name: total_load
query_bank.definition: mean normalized tactile response over every pooled sensor cell

query_bank.name: sensor_imbalance
query_bank.definition: difference between the first and last pooled tactile sensor means

query_bank.name: horizontal_balance
query_bank.definition: right-half minus left-half pooled tactile response

query_bank.name: vertical_balance
query_bank.definition: lower-half minus upper-half pooled tactile response

evaluation.decision_rule: execute when the predicted adverse-event probability is no greater than the constant fallback cost; otherwise take exact fallback

prob4d_semantics_tested: dependence-preserving low-rank-plus-local covariance versus same-mean same-marginal dependence destruction
claim_boundary: Retrospective mechanism evidence on the previously scored 92-object Deform360 cohort. A positive result isolates value in cross-coordinate dependence for registered tactile-field queries and an execute-versus-fallback risk decision. It does not establish a fresh held-out confirmation, actual Prob4D runtime integration, dense 4-D geometry, unseen-object transfer, strict individual counterfactuals, deployment safety, or automatic paper acceptance.
